title: Thacker Pass Class II Air Pollution Control Permit
summary: NDEP's Class II air permit defines emission limits and requires monitoring, recordkeeping, reporting, testing, and inspector access for the Thacker Pass facility.
key_findings: The permit sets enforceable facility emission limits.
It requires regular monitoring, records, reporting, and compliance testing.
NDEP states that the permit requires renewal every five years.
why_it_matters: It provides a precise operating-compliance contract to test against later records.
ftfn_relevance: Adds a named emissions and testing checklist.
Creates a renewal and compliance follow-up trail.
Keeps authorized limits separate from measured emissions.
evidence_limits: The permit does not prove current renewal or compliant operation.
It does not establish construction, commissioning, qualified output, or sustained production.
